app.title: The MONTE WO App — Product Concept, Coming Soon
app.description: Explore the planned MONTE WO app: independent discipline performance, training history and future social features. No app download or public athlete accounts yet.
app.headline: Your work.
app.intro: A focused home for your training, built around progress you can understand—and strength recognition you have to earn.
app.notice: PRODUCT CONCEPT — NOT A FUNCTIONAL APP
app.availability: No native app download, public athlete account or launch date is available. Joining the waitlist requests updates only.

features.title: A clear athlete dashboard.
features.text: A planned view of your own training and four independent discipline records. No combined strength score or automatic starting rank.

features.title: History that means something.
features.text: Working sets, training history and personal records are planned for the app. This website does not store your workouts.

features.title: A next step you can explain.
features.text: Progress toward a qualifying standard can only be shown after the relevant methodology and thresholds are approved. There is no official progress percentage today.

features.title: Community, on your terms.
features.text: Friends and leaderboards are future possibilities, not live features. Privacy, eligibility and moderation need to be defined before release.

features.title: Consistency, without free ranks.
features.text: Attendance, streaks, XP, account age and engagement will never award strength ranks. Qualifying performance—not activity—must earn the recognition.

standards.title: Launch Discipline Guide — Draft MONTE WO Variations
standards.description: Read the four proposed MONTE WO launch variations, equipment requirements and draft performance checks. These rules are not yet approved for official rank awards.
standards.headline: Learn the variation.
standards.intro: A general exercise guide is not automatically a ranking rulebook. These are the four proposed launch variations, drawn directly from the existing draft MONTE Standards.
standards.notice: DRAFT — NOT OFFICIAL. The judging protocol, demonstration footage and thresholds are not complete or approved. These summaries do not authorize official rank awards.
standards.safety: Choose manageable loads and suitable safety equipment. Stop for pain. Do not repeat a dangerous attempt to satisfy a camera angle or chase a rank.

cards.label: Squat
cards.equipment: Barbell, plates and a suitable rack with correctly set safeties or competent spotters. High- or low-bar placement is included in the existing draft.
cards.difference: Front squats and Smith-machine squats are different variations; they do not substitute for this draft standard.

cards.label: Bench Press
cards.equipment: Free-weight barbell, plates and a flat bench with suitable safeties or competent spotting. A visible controlled pause is part of the draft.
cards.difference: Dumbbell, incline and touch-and-go variations are not interchangeable with the paused-barbell draft.

cards.label: Deadlift
cards.equipment: Barbell and full-size plates on a suitable floor. The existing draft uses conventional stance and excludes straps.
cards.difference: The library’s Romanian deadlift guide is a different movement. Sumo, trap-bar, block and deficit pulls are not substitutes in this launch draft.

cards.label: Strict Biceps Curl
cards.equipment: Straight bar, matching plates and a rigid vertical wall. Head, upper back and buttocks contact the wall in the draft setup.
cards.difference: Dumbbell, EZ-bar and swinging curls are different variations. A dedicated technique demonstration for this exact variation is not yet available.

ranking.title: MONTE WO Strength Index — Four Disciplines, Draft Standards
ranking.description: Nine earned rank identities across Squat, Bench Press, Deadlift and Strict Biceps Curl. No ranks from XP or streaks. Methodology is draft, not official.
ranking.headline: Performance earns the rank.
ranking.body: Each discipline stands on its own. A qualifying performance must meet that discipline’s approved rules and thresholds. There is no overall rank, no free Debitan and no promotion for attendance, streaks, XP, account age or engagement.
ranking.status: Official rank awards are unavailable until the relevant standards are researched, tested and independently approved.
ranking.pilot: Existing restricted technical pilot · not a public app feature
